summary: Completed testing of QR Code Scanning System for Race Lap Control. All 14 backend API tests passed. Fixed a critical frontend bug where error messages were not displaying correctly due to platform interceptors consuming the fetch response body. Changed ScanConfirmPage.jsx to use XMLHttpRequest instead of fetch to avoid body stream issues.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend qr_scan.py correctly implements all 4 endpoints: race-status, athlete/{bib}, confirm-lap, generate-qr/{bib}
QR code generation uses qrcode library and saves to /app/backend/static/qrcodes/
Auto-DNF logic correctly checks if athlete is behind current race lap
Frontend QRScannerPage.jsx has proper data-testid attributes for testing
Frontend ScanConfirmPage.jsx was fixed to use XMLHttpRequest to avoid platform interceptor issues with fetch body stream
Race not started scenario correctly shows 'La carrera aún no ha comenzado' message
Non-existent BIB correctly shows 'Atleta con BIB X no encontrado' error

success_rate.frontend: 100% - All pages load correctly, error handling fixed

seed_data_creation: Created test athletes with BIB 101 (retired/DNF) and BIB 102 (active) for testing QR scan functionality
context_for_next_testing_agent: QR scan system fully tested. Race BYSD-2027 is active but hasn't started yet (scheduled for future). Test athletes BIB 101 (retired) and BIB 102 (active) exist in database. The confirm lap button only appears when race has started and athlete can complete the lap.

GET /api/qr-scan/race-status.description: Returns race_active, race_code, race_name, race_started, current_lap, seconds_remaining

GET /api/qr-scan/athlete/{bib}.description: Returns ScanResult with athlete info, lap status, can_complete flag. Returns 404 for non-existent BIB

POST /api/qr-scan/confirm-lap.description: Confirms lap completion or marks DNF. Validates lap number matches expected

POST /api/qr-scan/generate-qr/{bib}.description: Generates QR code image and base64 string for athlete

/scan.description: QR Scanner page loads correctly with race status, camera button, and manual BIB entry

/scan/confirmar?bib=X.description: Shows athlete info for valid BIB, error message for invalid BIB, race not started message when applicable

RaceControlPanel.description: Has 'Escáner QR' button that opens /scan in new tab

PreRegistrationManagement.description: Shows QR code link next to BIB when qr_code_url exists

bug_fixed.issue: ScanConfirmPage.jsx error handling showed 'Failed to execute json on Response: body stream already read' instead of actual API error message
bug_fixed.root_cause: Platform interceptors were consuming the fetch response body before the component could read it
bug_fixed.fix_applied: Changed from fetch() to XMLHttpRequest to avoid body stream issues, similar to fix already applied in InscripcionPage.jsx
